facts.text: CON IL CONTRIBUTO DELLA FONDAZIONE VITO CORLEONE

facts.why: Altobello sits in the opera box and eats the poisoned cannoli, but prosciutto and melon is not in any source I opened.
facts.fix: Don Altobello's opera box, before the cannoli

facts.text: hand-rolled in the kitchen while the family looks the other way
facts.why: The gnocchi scene for Mary and Vincent exists, but I could not open a source describing the kitchen or the family looking away.
facts.fix: Mary and Vincent's gnocchi, hand-rolled and far too close for cousins

vibe.verdict: A properly grand opera night in Palermo, with the cannoli and orange juice winks that a fan will love.
